text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Duramente-chan!
Trick or treaaat--!!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Treat.
Take this.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Thank you~☆
Guess I'll have to save my trick for next
time, then♪

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
A trick...
Should I have chosen trick?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Mayano might have prepared
a trick just for you, after all.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Tricks are the best part of Halloween, you
know!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Is that so...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...W-Well, who knows...
My little sister did say something
similar, though...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I agree with Cra-chan!
Pulling tricks is half the fun of
Halloween!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Since we're all here, Dura-san,
why don't you try trick-or-treating too?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! If you give it a try,
I'm sure you'll see how charming a trick
can be!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Costumes are essential for Halloween!
And playing tricks is all the more fun the
deeper into character you get!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
So with that in mind!
Duramente-san, you'll be Count Dracula,
and I shall be your loyal servant!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
—Lord Duramente, as my master,
please bear witness to this humble
servant's efforts.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Do I simply follow you?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes, my lord.
However, please carry yourself with the
dignity befitting a count.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Hmph... Understood.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
My, my... I've spotted our prey♪
You there—trick or trick.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
The only choice granted to you
is to offer your blood to Lord Duramente.
Now—

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! To Lord Duramente?!
Y-Yes... Do with me as you wish! Eeek♡

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Indeed...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...All I could manage was a nod.
Improvised acting is unexpectedly
difficult.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
And yet... even though she was the victim
of a trick, she seemed to be thoroughly
enjoying herself...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Um... w-would it be alright?
It seems it's my turn next, so...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I'm not very good at pranks, but...
Vivlos often begs me to play them on her,
so I can do that one...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Cheval told me to come to the gym alone,
but... hm?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: What's this? On the floor, something's—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
! Dark red... writing in blood?
...No, that couldn't be.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Take three steps right, five steps back,
close your eyes, and clasp your hands..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: —BOO!!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
H-How was that?
I thought catching you off guard like that
might work...
The trick is... not letting the other
person suspect a thing.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I-I see... Simple, yet remarkably
effective.
My heart is still racing...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Just like Cheval-chan did,
you can use the atmosphere of places like
this!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: And then—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Ngh?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, give you chills?
I just touched you with my icy-cold hands!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
When you're somewhere a little spooky,
even a simple trick gets your heart
pounding like crazy!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. ...Both Cheval's setup and
Kitasan's
choice of venue relied on simple tricks.
Perhaps even I could devise something
similar.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
So, how was it?
Did we manage to show you the fun of
playing tricks?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Having learned from everyone's
examples,
I believe I now understand what makes it
the essence of Halloween.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...In fact, I feel an urge to put what
I've learned into practice.
Though my acting could certainly use more
discipline.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yay♪ Well then,
why don't you try playing a trick on
someone?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Duramente and the others, dressed in
costume,
were having a lively conversation in the
hallway.
choice_data_list: Hey there, looks like you're having fun.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer. Perfect timing.
Trick or treat?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Trick, is it?
Very well—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...No, my acting is still far too
unpolished.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
My apologies. I will respond properly once
I have adequately prepared my trick.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I never expected to hear those words from
Duramente,
but I handed her the pouch of sweets I had
prepared
for today anyway.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
—
Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Crown was right.
A Halloween without tricks might indeed
be somewhat lacking.
